evidence: Homepage shows "共 8 个非遗项目" (8 heritage items) and displays 8 items in the listing grid: spring-festival, dragon-boat, paper-cutting, peking-opera, kunqu-opera, chinese-calligraphy, suzhou-embroidery, yixing-teapot

All 8 displayed items have valid categories: 春节(民俗活动), 端午龙舟(民俗活动), 剪纸(传统美术), 京剧(传统表演), 昆曲(传统表演), 书法(传统美术), 苏绣(传统工艺), 宜兴紫砂(传统工艺). Categories match the 4 supported types: Traditional Crafts, Performing Arts, Folk Activities, Traditional Art.

All 8 heritage cards display: (1) title in image alt and link, (2) brief description as paragraph (e.g., "春节是中国最重要的传统节日..."), (3) category label (e.g., "民俗活动"), (4) region/province information. Example: 春节 card shows category "民俗活动" and description paragraph visible.

Detail page for spring-festival displays: title "春节", category "民俗活动", region "北京 · 华夏大地", inclusion year "2006年入选", and full introduction text. Gallery contains 3 image thumbnails with selection capability.

Image gallery on detail page allows users to select each of 3 available images. Clicking thumbnail 1, 2, and 3 correctly updates the selection state. Only one image is selected at a time (state "selected" is only present on the clicked thumbnail).

Clicking "浏览更多项目" button on detail page navigated to project list on homepage (URL: http://localhost:7063/#categories). The listing grid with all 8 heritage items is displayed with search, filter, and sort controls.

Search: Typing "京剧" filtered results to 1 item. Category filter: Selecting "传统工艺" filtered to 2 items. Province filter: Selecting "江苏" combined with category filter to show only Jiangsu Traditional Crafts items. Sort: Changed from "按名称" to "按年份". All filters and sorts update the result count and displayed items correctly.

After setting category filter to "传统工艺", province filter to "江苏", and sort to "按年份", clicked on suzhou-embroidery detail page. Returned to project list via "浏览更多项目" button. All filters remain applied: category shows "传统工艺", province shows "江苏", sort shows "按年份", and 2 filtered items are displayed.

Clicking hotspot for peking-opera in panorama opened info overlay containing: title "京剧", category "传统表演", image, brief description "京剧是中国影响最大的戏曲剧种...", and "查看详情" (View Details) navigation link to detail page. Close and continue buttons also present.

Tested panorama rotation and zoom: (1) Zoom-in button successfully adjusted view, (2) Hotspots remained visible and clickable after zooming, (3) Clicked suzhou-embroidery hotspot after zoom to verify interactivity, (4) Drag on panorama viewer executes rotation input. Hotspots continue to be accessible throughout zoom and rotation operations without being permanently lost.

Set panorama zoom level by clicking zoom-in twice. Clicked peking-opera hotspot, opened overlay, navigated to detail page via "查看详情" link. Returned to panorama view via "返回全景探索" button. Same hotspots (suzhou-embroidery, peking-opera) visible at same zoom level, confirming camera orientation and zoom level restoration.
Navigated to /heritage/invalid-project-id. Page displays clear not-found message "未找到该非遗项目" (Heritage project not found) with "返回首页" (Return to homepage) link. No unrelated project details displayed.
